# Style guide: product names

Always write Sledgeworx with a capital S and no space. Our desktop app is Sledgeworx Studio, and the command-line tool is `swx`, always lowercase.

Refer to third-party products by their official names: GitHub, iPhone, macOS, PostgreSQL, and JavaScript. Don't abbreviate Kubernetes as K8s in customer-facing copy.

labels.notes: Trap case: lowercase "swx" and camel-case product names are correct.
